title: Gubat fisherfolk, artists use art to raise coastal road concerns

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Fisherfolk and artists in Gubat, Sorsogon, turned a photography and poetry gathering into an expression of opposition to proposed coastal road projects, drawing attention to concerns about the bay’s environment and the livelihoods tied to it. The activity, “LAKAT-LENTE nan RAWIT-DAWIT SA BAYBAYON: Photowalk x Poetry Reading at Gubat Bay,” held Oct.
